Data Mining HW1: Comprehensive EDA & Statistical Analysis on Sleep Efficiency¶

本 Notebook 整合了所有 EDA 分析與建模流程，並包含 Kaggle 資料集自動抓取機制。已完全移除 Wakeup time 以及 Light/Deep/REM sleep 欄位，重點聚焦於 Bedtime (入睡時間) 與 Sleep duration (睡眠時長) 之關聯性與對睡眠效率的交互作用分析。

章節大綱 (Table of Contents)¶

  1. 環境準備與套件匯入 (Setup & Imports)
  2. Kaggle 資料集自動抓取與載入 (Automated Kaggle Dataset Fetching & Data Loading)
  3. 入睡時間 (Bedtime) 與 睡眠時長 (Sleep Duration) 關聯與交互作用分析 (12:00 PM ~ 隔日 12:00 PM 線性時間軸)
  4. 人口統計與生活習慣分析 (Demographics & Lifestyle EDA)
  5. 睡眠時長與咖啡因分析 (Sleep Duration & Caffeine Analysis)
  6. Box-Cox 轉換與殘差診斷 (Box-Cox Transformation & Residual Diagnostics)
  7. 咖啡因二元分組 (0 vs >0) 交互作用檢定與顯著特徵視覺化 (Moderation Analysis & Slope Visualization)
  8. 總結與研究發現 (Summary & Insights)

本次重跑僅使用 Sleep_Efficiency_train_v2.csv；所有輸出重新計算。

3. 入睡時間 (Bedtime) 與 睡眠時長 (Sleep Duration) 關聯與交互作用分析 (線性時間軸: 中午 12:00 到隔天中午 12:00)¶

In [3]:
# 1. 解析 Bedtime 並提取小時與精確連續時間
bed_dt = pd.to_datetime(df['Bedtime'])
df['Bedtime_Hour'] = bed_dt.dt.hour

# 計算精確小時數（包含分鐘，例如 22:30 -> 22.5）
exact_hour = bed_dt.dt.hour + bed_dt.dt.minute / 60.0

# 轉換為「中午 12:00 到隔天中午 12:00」的線性時間軸 (範圍: 12.0 ~ 36.0)
# 若時間小於 12 點 (即凌晨 00:00 ~ 11:59)，加上 24 小時以維持跨日連續性
df['Bedtime_Linear'] = np.where(exact_hour < 12, exact_hour + 24, exact_hour)
df['Bedtime_Hour_Linear'] = np.where(df['Bedtime_Hour'] < 12, df['Bedtime_Hour'] + 24, df['Bedtime_Hour'])

# 2. 分組定義：早睡 (21:00-22:00)、正常 (23:00-00:00)、晚睡 (>00:00)
def categorize_bedtime(linear_hour):
    if linear_hour < 23:
        return 'Early (<23:00)'
    elif linear_hour <= 24:
        return 'Regular (23:00-00:00)'
    else:
        return 'Late (>00:00)'

df['Bedtime_Category'] = df['Bedtime_Hour_Linear'].apply(categorize_bedtime)

# 自訂 X 軸時間格式化函數：將 >= 24 的數值轉回 00:00 ~ 12:00 格式顯示
def format_linear_time(x, pos):
    h = int(round(x)) % 24
    return f"{h:02d}:00"

# 3. 繪製線性時間軸 (12:00 ~ 隔日 12:00) 之分佈與關聯迴歸圖

# 繪製：2. Bedtime_Category × Sleep Duration 對 Sleep Efficiency 的交互作用迴歸圖 (Interaction Effect)
g = sns.lmplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep duration',
    y='Sleep efficiency',
    hue='Bedtime_Category',
    hue_order=['Early (<23:00)', 'Regular (23:00-00:00)', 'Late (>00:00)'],
    palette='Set1',
    scatter=True,
    ci=95,
    x_jitter=0.15,
    scatter_kws={'alpha': 0.4, 's': 30},
    line_kws={'linewidth': 2},
    height=5,
    aspect=1.5
)
g.set_axis_labels('Sleep Duration (hours)', 'Sleep Efficiency')
g.fig.suptitle('Interaction Effect: Sleep Duration × Bedtime Category on Sleep Efficiency', y=1.03)
plt.show()

# 建立包含交互作用項之 OLS 迴歸模型：Sleep_Efficiency ~ Sleep_Duration * C(Bedtime_Category)
model_inter = smf.ols('Q("Sleep efficiency") ~ Q("Sleep duration") * C(Bedtime_Category)', data=df).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print("=== Bedtime Category × Sleep Duration 交互作用迴歸報告 (HC3 Robust) ===")
print(model_inter.summary())

# HC3 Robust Wald Test：檢驗整體交互作用
interaction_terms = [
    name for name in model_inter.params.index
    if 'Q("Sleep duration"):' in name
]

R = np.zeros((len(interaction_terms), len(model_inter.params)))
for i, term in enumerate(interaction_terms):
    R[i, model_inter.params.index.get_loc(term)] = 1

wald_result = model_inter.wald_test(R, scalar=True)
print("=== Interaction Wald Test (HC3 Robust) ===")
print(f"Wald chi-square = {wald_result.statistic:.4f}")
print(f"df = {len(interaction_terms)}")
print(f"p-value = {wald_result.pvalue:.6f}")
(NOTEBOOK_OUT / 'bedtime_duration_model.txt').write_text(str(model_inter.summary()), encoding='utf-8')

6. Box-Cox 資料轉換與 OLS 殘差診斷¶

In [7]:
# 對數據進行 Box-Cox 轉換以符合常態性與同變異性假設
cols = ["Sleep efficiency", "Sleep duration", "Caffeine consumption"]
df_bc = df.copy()
lambdas = {}

for col in cols:
    x = df[col].astype(float)
    valid = x.notna() & np.isfinite(x)
    x_valid = x[valid]
    shift = max(0, 1 - x_valid.min())
    x_shifted = x_valid + shift
    transformed, lam = boxcox(x_shifted)
    df_bc[col] = np.nan
    df_bc.loc[valid, col] = transformed
    lambdas[col] = {"lambda": lam, "shift": shift}

# OLS 迴歸模型殘差診斷圖 (Residuals vs Fitted)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))
for idx, (dataset, name) in enumerate([(df, "Original"), (df_bc, "Box-Cox")]):
    data = dataset[["Sleep duration", "Sleep efficiency"]].dropna()
    X = sm.add_constant(data["Sleep duration"])
    y = data["Sleep efficiency"]
    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

    sns.scatterplot(x=model.fittedvalues, y=model.resid, alpha=0.4, ax=axes[idx])
    sns.regplot(x=model.fittedvalues, y=model.resid, lowess=True, scatter=False, line_kws={"color": "red"}, ax=axes[idx])
    axes[idx].axhline(0, color="black", linestyle="--")
    axes[idx].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
    axes[idx].set_ylabel("Residuals")
    axes[idx].set_title(f"{name}: Residuals vs Fitted (R² = {model.rsquared:.4f})")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

7. 咖啡因二元分組 (0 vs 有攝取) 交互作用檢定與顯著特徵斜率視覺化¶

將 Caffeine consumption 二元分為兩類：

  • No Caffeine (0 mg)：無攝取咖啡因 (Caffeine consumption == 0)
  • With Caffeine (>0 mg)：有攝取咖啡因 (Caffeine consumption > 0)

針對所有特徵重新進行 HC3 Robust Wald Test 交互作用檢定。凡是檢定達顯著水準（p-value < 0.05）的特徵，將自動繪製：

  • 數值型特徵：散佈圖 + 兩類人群各自的線性迴歸擬合線（lmplot）並標註兩組斜率（Slope），直觀展示兩條線的斜率差異（交叉或發散），說明為何模型必須納入交互作用項。
  • 類別型特徵：分組盒鬚圖（Boxplot）+ 交互作用平均效應折線圖（Pointplot），直觀展示不同類別下咖啡因效應的反轉或斜率變化。
In [8]:
# 1. 將咖啡因分為兩類：0 (No Caffeine) 與 >0 (With Caffeine)
df_test = df.copy()
df_test["Caffeine_Binary"] = pd.cut(
    df_test["Caffeine consumption"],
    bins=[-0.001, 0, np.inf],
    labels=["No Caffeine (0 mg)", "With Caffeine (>0 mg)"]
)

print("=== 咖啡因二元分組樣本數統計 ===")
print(df_test["Caffeine_Binary"].value_counts(dropna=False))
print()

# 2. 定義欲檢定的數值型與類別型特徵
categorical_features = ["Gender", "Smoking status", "Bedtime_Category"]
exclude = {
    "ID", "Sleep efficiency", "Caffeine consumption", "Caffeine_Group", "Caffeine_group", "Caffeine_Binary",
    "Bedtime", "Bedtime_Hour", "Bedtime_Hour_Linear", "Wakeup time",
    "Deep sleep percentage", "Light sleep percentage", "REM sleep percentage"
}

numeric_features = [col for col in df_test.select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns if col not in exclude]
features = [(col, "numeric") for col in numeric_features] + [(col, "categorical") for col in categorical_features if col in df_test.columns]

# 3. 逐一進行 HC3 Robust Wald Test 交互作用檢定
results = []
models_dict = {}

for feature, feature_type in features:
    data = df_test[["Sleep efficiency", "Caffeine_Binary", feature]].dropna().copy()
    if data[feature].nunique() < 2:
        continue
    data["Caffeine_Binary"] = data["Caffeine_Binary"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
    if data["Caffeine_Binary"].nunique() < 2:
        continue

    if feature_type == "categorical":
        data[feature] = data[feature].astype("category")
        x = f'C(Q("{feature}"))'
    else:
        x = f'Q("{feature}")'

    group = "C(Caffeine_Binary)"
    formula_main = f'Q("Sleep efficiency") ~ {x} + {group}'
    formula_interaction = f'Q("Sleep efficiency") ~ {x} * {group}'

    try:
        model_main = smf.ols(formula_main, data=data).fit(cov_type="HC3")
        model_interaction = smf.ols(formula_interaction, data=data).fit(cov_type="HC3")

        interaction_terms = [name for name in model_interaction.params.index if ":" in name]
        if len(interaction_terms) == 0:
            continue

        param_names = list(model_interaction.params.index)
        R = np.zeros((len(interaction_terms), len(param_names)))
        for i, term in enumerate(interaction_terms):
            R[i, param_names.index(term)] = 1

        wald = model_interaction.wald_test(R, scalar=True, use_f=False)
        pval = float(wald.pvalue)

        results.append({
            "Feature": feature,
            "Type": feature_type,
            "N": len(data),
            "Wald chi2": float(wald.statistic),
            "p-value": pval,
            "Significant (p<0.05)": "Yes (*)" if pval < 0.05 else "No",
            "R2 Main": model_main.rsquared,
            "R2 Interaction": model_interaction.rsquared,
            "Delta R2": model_interaction.rsquared - model_main.rsquared
        })
        models_dict[feature] = (model_interaction, data, feature_type, pval)
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Interaction model failed: {feature}") from e

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
results_df["FDR p-value"] = multipletests(results_df["p-value"], method="fdr_bh")[1]
results_df = results_df.sort_values("p-value").reset_index(drop=True)

print("=== 咖啡因二元分組 (0 vs >0) 交互作用 Wald 檢定結果 (HC3 Robust) ===")
display(results_df.round(4))

# 4. 自動篩選出 p-value < 0.05 的顯著交互作用特徵，並繪製斜率差異與分組比較圖
sig_features = results_df[results_df["p-value"] < 0.05]["Feature"].tolist()

print(f"檢定顯著 (p-value < 0.05) 的交互作用特徵共 {len(sig_features)} 個: {sig_features}\n")

palette_map = {
    "No Caffeine (0 mg)": "#1f77b4",
    "With Caffeine (>0 mg)": "#e63946"
}

for feat in sig_features:
    model_inter, data_sub, f_type, pval = models_dict[feat]
    print("=" * 85)
    print(f"★ 顯著交互作用特徵: 【{feat}】 ({f_type}) | Interaction Wald p-value = {pval:.4e}")
    print("=" * 85)

    if f_type == "numeric":
        # 計算兩群人各自的線性斜率 (Slope) 與截距 (Intercept)
        slopes_info = {}
        for grp in ["No Caffeine (0 mg)", "With Caffeine (>0 mg)"]:
            sub = data_sub[data_sub["Caffeine_Binary"] == grp]
            if len(sub) > 2:
                res = stats.linregress(sub[feat], sub["Sleep efficiency"])
                slopes_info[grp] = (res.slope, res.intercept, res.rvalue, res.pvalue)
                print(f"  - {grp:<22}: Slope (斜率) = {res.slope:+.5f}, Intercept = {res.intercept:.4f}, r = {res.rvalue:+.3f} (p={res.pvalue:.3e})")

        slope_diff = slopes_info["With Caffeine (>0 mg)"][0] - slopes_info["No Caffeine (0 mg)"][0]
        print(f"  => 兩組斜率差 (ΔSlope = With - No Caffeine): {slope_diff:+.5f} (斜率顯著不同，代表咖啡因改變了 {feat} 對睡眠效率的影響方向/強度！)")

        # 繪製雙圖：左圖為散點圖 + 兩組線性擬合線 (直觀展現斜率差異)，右圖為依特徵區間切分的 Boxplot
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 5.5))

        # 左圖：散點圖與線性迴歸線 (展現斜率不同)
        for grp, color in palette_map.items():
            sub = data_sub[data_sub["Caffeine_Binary"] == grp]
            slp, icpt, r_val, _ = slopes_info[grp]
            sns.regplot(
                data=sub,
                x=feat,
                y="Sleep efficiency",
                x_jitter=0.12 if data_sub[feat].nunique() < 15 else 0,
                color=color,
                scatter_kws={"alpha": 0.45, "s": 35},
                line_kws={"linewidth": 2.5, "label": f"{grp}\n(Slope = {slp:+.4f}, r = {r_val:+.2f})"},
                ax=axes[0]
            )

        if feat == "Bedtime_Linear":
            axes[0].set_xlim(18, 30)
            axes[0].xaxis.set_major_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(2))
            axes[0].xaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(format_linear_time))
            axes[0].set_xlabel("Bedtime (Linear Scale: 18:00 to Next Day 06:00)")

        axes[0].set_title(f"Interaction Slope Comparison: {feat} × Caffeine\n(Wald p = {pval:.4f}, ΔSlope = {slope_diff:+.4f})", fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
        axes[0].set_ylabel("Sleep Efficiency")
        axes[0].legend(loc="best", frameon=True, title="Caffeine Group & Fitted Slope")

        # 右圖：將數值特徵分箱或按離散值繪製 Boxplot，直觀比較兩群人在不同水準下的分佈差異
        data_plot = data_sub.copy()
        if data_plot[feat].nunique() <= 6:
            x_col = feat
        else:
            x_col = f"{feat}_Binned"
            data_plot[x_col] = pd.qcut(data_plot[feat], q=3, duplicates='drop')

        sns.boxplot(
            data=data_plot,
            x=x_col,
            y="Sleep efficiency",
            hue="Caffeine_Binary",
            palette=palette_map,
            ax=axes[1]
        )
        axes[1].set_title(f"Boxplot Distribution Across {feat} Levels by Caffeine", fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
        axes[1].set_ylabel("Sleep Efficiency")
        axes[1].legend(loc="best", title="Caffeine Intake")

        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()

    else:
        # 類別型特徵：繪製 Boxplot (左圖) + Pointplot 交互作用斜率連線圖 (右圖)
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(15, 5.5))

        cat_order = sorted(data_sub[feat].unique())
        if feat == "Bedtime_Category":
            cat_order = [c for c in ['Early (<23:00)', 'Regular (23:00-00:00)', 'Late (>00:00)'] if c in data_sub[feat].unique()]

        # 左圖：分組 Boxplot
        sns.boxplot(
            data=data_sub,
            x=feat,
            y="Sleep efficiency",
            hue="Caffeine_Binary",
            order=cat_order,
            palette=palette_map,
            ax=axes[0]
        )
        axes[0].set_title(f"Boxplot: {feat} × Caffeine on Sleep Efficiency\n(Wald p = {pval:.4f})", fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
        axes[0].set_ylabel("Sleep Efficiency")
        axes[0].legend(loc="best", title="Caffeine Intake")

        # 右圖：Pointplot 均值連線圖 (直觀展現兩條線不平行/交叉的斜率差異)
        sns.pointplot(
            data=data_sub,
            x=feat,
            y="Sleep efficiency",
            hue="Caffeine_Binary",
            order=cat_order,
            palette=palette_map,
            markers=["o", "s"],
            linestyles=["-", "--"],
            dodge=0.15,
            capsize=0.1,
            ax=axes[1]
        )
        axes[1].set_title(f"Interaction Slope Plot (Mean ± 95% CI): {feat} × Caffeine\n(Non-parallel lines indicate significant interaction!)", fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
        axes[1].set_ylabel("Mean Sleep Efficiency")
        axes[1].legend(loc="best", title="Caffeine Intake")

        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()

        # 印出各組平均值差異
        grp_means = data_sub.groupby([feat, "Caffeine_Binary"], observed=False)["Sleep efficiency"].agg(["count", "mean", "std"])
        display(grp_means.round(4))
    print("\n")
